intro: At the end of the sea cave path, the Dragon Master Lance stands with a Shiny Gyarados.
introDialogue: There you are. Ahead lies the Sea God's Heart. The power of dragons and the sea pulses through this cavern. Will you harness this power, or use it to awaken your Pokemon's true potential? Show me your resolve!
speaker: Lance
title: The Sea God's Heart
description: A heart sleeps in the deep cave. The black pulse lifts power, and the white pulse amplifies the mind.

1.label: Follow the black pulse
1.tooltip: (+) The chosen Pokemon learns Power Trip / (-) HP 50%

2.label: Hear the white pulse
2.tooltip: (+) The chosen Pokemon learns Stored Power / (-) HP 50%

3.label: Quiet the heart
3.tooltip: (+) Chosen Pokemon gets 6V and passive unlocked / (-) HP 50%

option.selected: A fine choice! Let the pulse flow!
option.cost: The pulse was intense, but your Pokemon withstood it!

outro: Our paths will cross again at the Pokemon League. Keep training!
